title: pelargonium scabrum
intro: Pelargonium scabrum, commonly known as the rough-leaved geranium, is a species of flowering plant in the family Geraniaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in South Africa, where it has been employed to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Pelargonium scabrum include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of sore throats, coughs, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
